description: Netlife Craft CMS update policy. Sites extend this with one line.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Monthly fresh resolve of composer.lock, the first Monday. Moves the packages only the lock names, which no direct update ever touches. Labelled preview, merged by a developer.

packageRules.description: Look up versions on Packagist only. Sites list composer.craftcms.com as a non-canonical mirror, but Renovate takes the first registry that answers, and that mirror serves stale version lists for third-party packages.
Patch updates, one PR a week, automerged when verify is green.
Minor updates, one PR a month on the second Monday, a week after lock file maintenance. Always merged by a developer. Labelled preview so craft-preview builds a site to look at.
Majors are project work, never automated.
Vulnerability fixes open immediately; patch-level fixes automerge when verify is green.
